recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern album cover featuring a painterly illustration of a male musician in a light blue suit standing next to a stylized grand piano. The background is composed of large, textured color blocks in ochre, vibrant orange, and a sky-blue header bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center balanced by the large diagonal mass of the piano on the right.
A horizontal blue header bar containing script text contrasts with the verticality of the figure.
Textured, visible brushstrokes in the background blocks create a sense of depth and movement.
coreInvariants: Stylized, brown grand piano with white outline highlights.
Musician in a light blue suit with visible painterly texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length figure on the left third, scaled to approximately 60% of vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, solid mass of the grand piano on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the script title in the blue bar, moves down to the artist name, then follows the musician's gaze toward the piano.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open areas of flat color in the background blocks provide breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange block contrasts with the muted, earthy ochre and the bright, clean blue header.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses a fluid, monolinear cursive script with long, sweeping flourishes on the 'I' and 'S'.
Artist name uses a heavy, extra-condensed sans-serif with flat terminals and tight tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' in the script title is elongated into a horizontal oval flourish.
The 'S' in the script has a large, looping descender/ascender tail.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between fluid, organic script and rigid, industrial condensed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Minimalist line art for piano details

preserve: The condensed nature of the secondary text
avoid: Clean, vector-perfect edges on the illustration

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy sans-serif style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A painterly mid-century illustration of a man in a light blue suit standing by a brown grand piano. The background consists of a large mustard yellow block on the left and a vibrant orange block on the right, with a solid sky-blue horizontal bar across the top. Use visible gouache brushstrokes and white line-art highlights on the piano.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white monolinear script title centered in the blue bar. Below the blue bar, add a black, extra-condensed bold sans-serif name centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the blue bar at the top solid and distinct?
Does the suit have painterly texture rather than flat color?
Is the script title monolinear and fluid?
Is the secondary text heavily condensed?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the musician
Record label logos and catalog numbers
Specific signature in the bottom right
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the piano is stylized with white outlines.
Verify the script text is white and the condensed text is black.
Check that the background colors are separated into distinct blocks.
Confirm the painterly texture is visible across the entire illustration.
recipe.reuseFormula: Painterly Figure + Stylized Instrument + Tri-Color Block Background + Script/Condensed Type Pairing
